title: Add a way to copy a shape's dimensions and apply them to other shapes
reason: A user asks to copy the final dimensions of a resized YouTube/video frame to other shapes so a batch of embeds can be made consistent. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A useful multi-object layout workflow; Varve's existing copy-style, inspector multi-edit, and size fields need comparison before adding a new command.

title: Wacom pen double-tap doesn't enter text editing on first load, and dragging is intermittently unresponsive
reason: Reports Wacom double-tap-to-edit failing on first file load and intermittent drag failure, with refresh temporarily changing behavior. The issue explicitly says the broader drag failure is hard to pinpoint; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A device-specific input lifecycle lead; no Varve Wacom reproduction or hardware evidence was collected.

title: Remove the crawler-era single-flight structures from the OG thumbnail pipeline
reason: Proposes simplifying the hosted OG-thumbnail pipeline now that crawler-triggered rendering has been retired. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is a service-internal Cloudflare thumbnail architecture cleanup, not a Varve website behavior issue.

title: Remove the legacy user-owns-file model from tldraw.com
reason: Requests removing obsolete user-owned-file compatibility after all hosted users moved to group/workspace ownership, including dead columns, triggers, and stale flags. No comments were available; this is a server schema/data migration.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's local document ownership model does not use tldraw.com's group/file schema.

title: Record room deletions in a durable audit table
reason: Requests a durable record of deleted hosted rooms, including time, actor, and reason, beyond a reversible `isDeleted` state. It concerns account deletion and service auditability; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no hosted room/account-deletion service; this is not a local undo/history audit requirement.

title: Allow multiple sizes of text in a text box
reason: The comment says the SDK already supports multiple font sizes through its rich-text-font-extensions example, but tldraw.com intentionally does not expose that capability; markdown headings are offered as a workaround. The request is about the hosted product, not an SDK limitation.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's design/typography workflow may benefit from mixed-size rich text, but existing text run capabilities and editing UI were not inspected in this review.

title: Some keyboard shortcuts impossible when attempting to internationalize
reason: Reports that action overrides cannot express some shortcut mappings needed for international keyboard layouts. The body includes a long screenshot; it was not replayed. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A keyboard layout extension lead related to #9862; Varve's shortcut configuration and non-US layouts were not inspected.

title: Sync client throws when a message arrives on an orphaned websocket
reason: Reports that a late message from an old orphaned socket reaches a handler that asserts the socket must already be closing/closed, generating production errors. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not ship this shared tldraw sync client; no local WebSocket collaboration path was reproduced.

title: Sync client can stay online while its websocket is still connecting, causing send failures
reason: Describes a reconnect path where state remains online after swapping in a new CONNECTING socket, so throttled document sends throw `InvalidStateError`. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No equivalent synchronized document websocket client exists in Varve's current collaboration stub.

title: Sync sessions are rejected with an unknown error when a client's v1 schema has no recordVersions
reason: The reply confirms #10220 makes `upgradeSchema` return a structured error for missing v1 recordVersions, which TLSyncRoom maps to a version-mismatch rejection instead of an unknown exception.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an upstream sync protocol schema upgrade fix; Varve has no matching room/session service.
